tweets: Why consider sermorelin or secretagogues instead of direct GH? Beyond cost, there's a clinical rationale for this category worth understanding before exploring options.

Direct GH therapy involves administering the hormone itself, while sermorelin and secretagogues are designed to support the body's own regulatory processes. Clinicians weigh these approaches based on individual patient needs and clinical judgment.

Secretagogues may require more time to observe changes, reflecting the complexity of hormone regulation. This approach is not appropriate or necessary for everyone and depends on careful clinical evaluation.
